description: This PHP class 'FilterParams' defines filtering parameters for data retrieval, including sorting order, sorting field, limit, and offset, with validation for sort order.

classes.name: FilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for encapsulating filtering and sorting parameters, with default values and validation.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the current sort order ('ASC' or 'DESC').

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order; validates that it is either 'ASC' or 'DESC', throws SearchParamException otherwise.

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Returns the field name used for sorting, if set.

methods.name: setSortField
methods.description: Sets the field name used for sorting.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit on number of results.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the limit on number of results.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for data retrieval.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for data retrieval.
